description: Summary: every GCM consensus match scored against genomic background, with conservation and experimental status
code:
import numpy as np, requests, re, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd
def rd(c): return open(f"out/{c}.fa").read().strip()
def rc(s): return s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))
bg=rd("bg1")+rd("bg2")+rd("bg3")
freq=np.array([bg.count(b) for b in "ACGT"],float); freq/=freq.sum()
d=requests.get("https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/MA0767.2/?format=json",timeout=40).json()
M=np.array([d["pfm"][b] for b in "ACGT"],float)
W=np.log2(((M+1.0)/(M.sum(0,keepdims=True)+4.0))/freq[:,None]); w=M.shape[1]
IX={b:i for i,b in enumerate("ACGT")}
def sc(seq):
    lut=np.full(256,-1,np.int64)
    for b,i in IX.items(): lut[ord(b)]=i
    code=lut[np.frombuffer(seq.encode(),np.uint8)]; valid=code>=0; code=np.where(valid,code,0)
    n=len(seq)-w+1; s=np.zeros(n); ok=np.ones(n,bool)
    for j in range(w): s+=W[code[j:j+n],j]; ok&=valid[j:j+n]
    s[~ok]=-999; return s
bgs=np.concatenate([sc(bg),sc(rc(bg))]); bgs=bgs[bgs>-900]
thr4=np.quantile(bgs,1-1e-4); thr5=np.quantile(bgs,1-1e-5)
def score_word(word):
    return sum(W[IX[c],j] for j,c in enumerate(word))
pts=[("gcm -4062\nATGCGGGC","ATGCGGGC",True,"functional (cis-perturbation)"),
     ("pks -1437\nATGCGGGT","ATGCGGGT",False,"functional (cis-perturbation)"),
     ("pks +5020\nATGCGGGT","ATGCGGGT",False,"not tested"),
     ("pks +7111\nATGCGGAC","ATGCGGAC",False,"not tested"),
     ("gatae -12448\nATGCGGAT","ATGCGGAT",False,"candidate under test")]
fig,(ax1,ax2)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.2),gridspec_kw=dict(width_ratios=[1.25,1]))
ax1.hist(bgs,bins=160,color="#b8b8b8",log=True)
ax1.axvline(thr4,color="#2980b9",ls="--",lw=1.2); ax1.axvline(thr5,color="#8e44ad",ls=":",lw=1.5)
ax1.text(thr4,3e5,f" p=1e-4\n {thr4:.1f}",color="#2980b9",fontsize=8,va="top")
ax1.text(thr5,3e5,f" p=1e-5\n {thr5:.1f}",color="#8e44ad",fontsize=8,va="top")
cols={"functional (cis-perturbation)":"#c0392b","not tested":"#7f8c8d","candidate under test":"#e67e22"}
ys=[2e5,4e4,8e3,1.6e3,3e2]
for (lab,word,consv,kind),y in zip(pts,ys):
    s=score_word(word)
    ax1.annotate(lab.replace("\n"," "), (s,y), xytext=(-8,0), textcoords="offset points", ha="right",
                 fontsize=8.5, color=cols[kind],
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color=cols[kind],lw=1.2))
    ax1.plot([s],[y],"o",color=cols[kind],ms=7)
ax1.set_xlabel("GCM2 PWM log-odds score (bits), JASPAR MA0767.2")
ax1.set_ylabel("genomic positions (1.5 Mb, both strands)")
ax1.set_title("All ATGCGGRY matches scored against the\nS. purpuratus genomic score distribution",fontsize=10,loc="left")

tab=pd.DataFrame([dict(site="gcm -4062", word="ATGCGGGC", bits=round(score_word("ATGCGGGC"),2), Lv_conserved="yes", evidence="cis-perturbation"),
                  dict(site="pks -1437", word="ATGCGGGT", bits=round(score_word("ATGCGGGT"),2), Lv_conserved="no", evidence="cis-perturbation"),
                  dict(site="pks +5020", word="ATGCGGGT", bits=round(score_word("ATGCGGGT"),2), Lv_conserved="no", evidence="none"),
                  dict(site="pks +7111", word="ATGCGGAC", bits=round(score_word("ATGCGGAC"),2), Lv_conserved="n/a", evidence="none"),
                  dict(site="gatae -12448", word="ATGCGGAT", bits=round(score_word("ATGCGGAT"),2), Lv_conserved="no", evidence="none")])
ax2.axis("off")
t=ax2.table(cellText=tab.values, colLabels=["site (rel. TSS)","8-mer","PWM bits","conserved in\nL. variegatus","experimental\nsupport"],
            loc="center", cellLoc="center")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(9); t.scale(1,1.9)
for i in range(5): t[(1,i)].set_facecolor("#f6d5d0")
for i in range(5): t[(5,i)].set_facecolor("#fde8d0")
ax2.set_title("Every GCM consensus match in the three loci",fontsize=10,loc="left")
fig.suptitle("The gataE locus contains no GCM site comparable to the validated Gcm sites of gcm and pks",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
tab.to_csv("out/site_table.csv",index=False); print(tab.to_string(index=False))
